description: This is a Streamlit application script for a medical exam preparation chatbot that uses retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with vector search and OpenAI's API. It manages UI layout, session state, and integrates with external modules for embeddings, vector storage, and language model interactions.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A class for managing vector storage and similarity search for document chunks.

classes.name: EmbeddingManager
classes.description: A class for generating embeddings from text using a specified model.

methods.name: generate_rag_answer
methods.description: Asynchronous function that performs embedding of the question, searches relevant document chunks, constructs a prompt, and calls the OpenAI API to generate an answer based on retrieved context.
